content:
We’ve received a review sample for the Timekettle LiveTalk, a pair of open-ear earbuds that supports real-time AI translation and AI-powered conversation summaries. It supports 53 languages and 107 accents, including 25 language pairs available offline. I’ll start with an unboxing, share my experience using the LiveTalk as standard earbuds, then focus on the AI translation features by watching videos in German and Thai and discussing in Thai and French, both face-to-face and over the phone. Timekettle LiveTalk unboxing The retail package highlights the key features of the Timekettle “LiveTalk AI translation Earbuds”, which support Bluetooth connectivity, AI, and up to 8 hours/35 hours (with case) of battery life.  It also mentions 53 supported languages, AI live summaries, privacy protection/GDPR compliance, and an “all-day comfort” open-ear design. You’ll find the charging case, a USB-C to USB-A charging cable, a Quick Start Guide in English, and a multilingual safety sheet in [...]
